incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired — service=inference-api-eu, symptom=p99 latency > 600ms (now 760ms). Pager: PD#12345 auto-page to @eng-oncall
Alex: Ack. I'm on it, checking dashboards.
Alex: p95 ~420ms, p99 ~760ms, tail spike started ~T-3m, QPS stable. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc123/inference-latency
Priya: Thanks — any obvious region/host hot spots?
Alex: EU-west mostly, host group r5g-infer-03/04 showing KV cache miss spikes and tokenizer backfills.
Maya: looks like tokenizer coldstarts — tokenization latency up after recent model roll, miss rate on kvcache 18% -> 42%.
Carlos (support): we've had 3 customer tickets about slow chat responses in EU; CS-987, CS-990, CS-991. No SLA escalations yet.
Alex: Immediate plan: 1) scale up inference pool +2 nodes, 2) nudge autoscaler min replicas, 3) route 30% traffic to us-east fallback variant, 4) enable prefix/KV caching for hotkeys.
Priya: I'm applying scale now (kubectl scale deployment/inference-eu --replicas=+2). Will monitor. Also flip routing via router service rollout.
Alex: Rolling routing change: 10%->30% now. Observability: p99 dropped to 540ms at T+3m after partial reroute.
Jenna (PM): Keep me posted on customer impact and ETA to normal.
Priya: Autoscale up complete, +2 nodes warming. KV miss rate dropping, p99 trending down.
Alex: Completed caching enable on hot prefixes. p95 210ms, p99 320ms after 8m. Keeping oncall.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: alert still firing but no escalation — acknowledged by Alex
Carlos (support): CS update sent: customers notified of degradation and being monitored. No downtime.
Alex: handing off to Priya for remainder of shift — will update Handoff doc: https://wiki.redwood/infer/handoffs/1819990001
Priya: Taking over. I'll keep scaling enabled for 30m and watch for regression. If p99 > 600ms again, we'll open incident channel.
Carlos: closing customer tickets as monitored; will reopen if regress.
